# opnsense_nginx_tls_fingerprint (Resource)

nginx TLS fingerprints (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ HTTP(S) ▸ TLS Fingerprint**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ciphers` (String) Enter a list of elliptic curves supported by the client in a standard configuration in OpenSSL syntax (cipher1:cipher2:0x0001).
- `description` (String) Enter a useful description for your entry.
- `user_agent` (String) User Agent.

### Optional

- `curves` (String) Enter a list of elliptic curves supported by the client in a standard configuration in OpenSSL syntax (curve1:curve2:0x0001). Defaults to ``.
- `trusted` (Boolean) If you check this box, this entry will be added to the configuration of trusted fingerprints. Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx TLS fingerprint.
